prompt:
You are an independent senior art director and technical-art reviewer. Attack this calibration artifact; do not praise it by default and do not infer quality from structural pass statuses. Review the attached runtime screenshot plus this factual evidence bundle: {
  "artifact": "Emberveil \u2014 Warden of Dying Fires",
  "mission": "calibration instrument for creative production intelligence, not a finished commercial product",
  "structural": {
    "valid": true,
    "mesh_count": 13,
    "material_count": 4,
    "animation_count": 4,
    "node_count": 18
  },
  "render_evidence": [
    "960x540 Cycles preview",
    "24-frame turntable",
    "72-frame cinematic sequence",
    "H.264 turntable and cinematic encodes"
  ],
  "runtime_observation": {
    "hero_loaded": true,
    "active_animation_count": 4,
    "ember_particles": 420,
    "console_errors": 0,
    "network_failures": 0
  },
  "perceptual_diagnostics": {
    "readability_gate": "PASS",
    "black_crush": "diagnostic pass",
    "limitation": "metrics do not prove artistic quality"
  },
  "known_risk": "procedurally authored lathed vessel and shrine; no texture images; no audio; no authored ignition performance; rig controls are not skinned"
}.

Return JSON with exactly these keys:
critical_blockers (array), professional_gaps (array), primitive_or_generic_elements (array), strongest_identity_signals (array), actionable_repairs (array), verdict (one of COHERENT, POLISHED, PRODUCTION, SIGNATURE), confidence (0..1), limitations (array).
Be specific about silhouette, material readability, lighting, composition, environment, motion, VFX, typography, and runtime cohesion. Reject false completion.
review:
```json
{
  "critical_blockers": [
    "Faceted low-poly silhouette on central vessel hull breaks form readability. Missing normal smoothing or adaptive subdivision.",
    "Zero surface texture data. Flat procedural shaders create synthetic plastic appearance under direct light.",
    "Unskinned rigid hierarchy prevents organic mechanical or flame deformation."
  ],
  "professional_gaps": [
    "Void background lacks environmental depth, grounding floor, distant silhouette, or volumetric fog.",
    "Ember particles lack velocity turbulence, size variation over life, and screen-space bloom response.",
    "Braziers act as unlit geometric placeholders. No fuel source, internal fire, or soot weathering.",
    "Lighting model has harsh disconnected blue rim light with no scene origin point.",
    "Missing audio and authored ignition stage."
  ],
  "primitive_or_generic_elements": [
    "Braziers built from default chamfered cylinder primitives.",
    "Torus platform floor devoid of architectural segmentation or material breakup.",
    "Point-sprite ember particles without sub-frame motion blur or custom sprites.",
    "Lathed central sphere vessel lacks surface articulation."
  ],
  "strongest_identity_signals": [
    "Subsurface red translucent bowl under central vessel creates clear primary focal point.",
    "Warm core versus cool rim lighting palette establishes intended mood.",
    "Minimalist typography and UI framing provide deliberate art direction target."
  ],
  "actionable_repairs": [
    "Apply smooth vertex normals or subdivision modifier to central vessel mesh.",
    "Add procedural noise-based roughness, normal map variation, and edge wear to shader nodes.",
    "Attach dynamic point lights to braziers and sync ember emission to central core intensity.",
    "Add ground contact plane, volumetric haze, and bloom post-processing pass.",
    "Introduce particle curl noise and scale decay curves to ember system."
  ],
  "verdict": "COHERENT",
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "limitations": [
    "Review based on single runtime still frame and metadata bundle.",
    "Animation curves, interactive performance, and frame pacing unverified in real time."
  ]
}
```
independence: separate reviewer prompt/model family; builder summary not supplied
